facts.fact_text: According to the applicant, the demonstrations of 31 July 2010 and 10 March 2013 were intended to be peaceful.
According to the applicant, the demonstrations of 31 July 2010 and 10 March 2013 were conducted in a peaceful manner.
According to the applicant, the participants of the demonstration of 31 July 2010 were demanding free and fair elections and democratic reforms in Azerbaijan.
According to the applicant, the participants of the demonstration of 10 March 2013 were protesting over the deaths of numerous soldiers in the army.
Shortly after the demonstration of 31 July 2010 had begun, the police started to disperse those who had gathered.
Shortly after the demonstration of 10 March 2013 had begun, the police started to disperse those who had gathered.
The applicant was arrested during the dispersal operation at the demonstration of 31 July 2010.
The applicant was arrested during the dispersal operation at the demonstration of 10 March 2013.
On the day of the applicant's arrest following the demonstration of 31 July 2010, an administrative offence report (inzibati xəta haqqında protokol) was issued on the applicant.
On the day of the applicant's arrest following the demonstration of 10 March 2013, an administrative offence report (inzibati xəta haqqında protokol) was issued on the applicant.
By a decision of 31 July 2010, the Sabail District Court (first-instance court) convicted the applicant under Article 310.1 of the Code of Administrative Offences (CAO).
By a decision of 11 March 2013, the Sabail District Court (first-instance court) convicted the applicant under Article 298.2 of the Code of Administrative Offences (CAO).
By a decision of 31 July 2010, the Sabail District Court (first-instance court) sentenced the applicant to seven days' administrative detention.
By a decision of 11 March 2013, the Sabail District Court (first-instance court) sentenced the applicant to seven days' administrative detention.

At the time of the applicant's arrest on 31 July 2010, Article 298 of the Code of Administrative Offences 2000 (CAO) provided that any breach of the rules, set forth under the legislation, on the organisation and holding of assemblies, demonstrations, protests, marches and pickets shall be punishable by a reprimand or a fine of seven to thirteen manats (AZN).

At the time of the applicant's arrest on 31 July 2010, Article 310.1 of the Code of Administrative Offences 2000 (CAO) provided that deliberate failure by an individual to comply with a lawful order of a police officer or military serviceman carrying out their duties to protect public order shall be punishable by a fine of twenty to twenty-five manats (AZN) or, if that sanction is inadequate in the circumstances of the case and taking into account the character of the offender, by up to fifteen days' administrative detention.

At the time of the applicant's arrest on 31 July 2010, Article 410.3 of the Code of Administrative Offences 2000 (CAO) provided that an individual who is subject to administrative offence proceedings or a representative of a legal entity shall be given an opportunity to familiarise himself with the administrative offence report.

At the time of the applicant's arrest on 31 July 2010, Article 410.4 of the Code of Administrative Offences 2000 (CAO) provided that an individual who is subject to administrative offence proceedings or a representative of a legal entity has the right to a copy of the administrative offence report.

At the time of the applicant's arrest on 31 July 2010, Article 437.2 of the Code of Administrative Offences 2000 (CAO) provided that a copy of a decision delivered on the basis of an appeal or a protest against a decision in an administrative offence case shall be given to the individual with respect to whom the decision in an administrative offence case was adopted within three days of its adoption.

At the time of the applicant's arrest on 31 July 2010, Article 437.3 of the Code of Administrative Offences 2000 (CAO) provided that a copy of a decision delivered on the basis of an appeal or a protest against a decision sentencing an individual to administrative detention shall be given to that individual on the day of its adoption.
Law no. 462-IVQD of 2 November 2012 entered into force on 1 January 2013.
Law no. 462-IVQD of 2 November 2012 introduced new wording to Article 298 of the Code of Administrative Offences (CAO) concerning breach of the rules on the organisation and holding of assemblies.

Following the amendment introduced by Law no. 462-IVQD of 2 November 2012, participation in an assembly organised in breach of the rules on the organisation and holding of assemblies became explicitly punishable under Article 298.2 of the Code of Administrative Offences (CAO).
Law no. 462-IVQD of 2 November 2012 introduced for the first time a punishment in the form of administrative detention of up to 15 days under Article 298 of the Code of Administrative Offences (CAO).
